title: Android App Engineer
description:
Role Overview 
 As an Android Engineer, you will be responsible for owning and enhancing our dedicated tablet-based Android application. Your core focus will be split between ensuring the stability and performance of the existing application and architecting scalable new features. Because this is a tablet-first experience, you will leverage modern Kotlin development patterns to build highly responsive, adaptive layouts that maximize larger screen real estate. You will collaborate closely with product and UI/UX teams to translate complex workflows into seamless, reliable mobile experiences. 

 Key Responsibilities 
 App Development: Write clean, efficient, and maintainable Kotlin code to build modern Android applications. UI/UX Implementation: Create responsive user interfaces using Jetpack Compose or traditional Android Views. Architecture Design: Apply patterns like MVVM (Model-View-ViewModel), Clean Architecture, and SOLID principles. API Integration: Connect mobile apps to backend services, RESTful APIs, and cloud messaging (e.g., Retrofit, OkHttp, Firebase). Concurrency Performance: Manage background tasks using Kotlin Coroutines and Flow, and optimize app startup, memory usage, and battery life. Testing Quality Assurance: Write unit tests, UI tests, and participate in code reviews. CI/CD Deployment: Use tools like Gradle, Git, and CI/CD pipelines to build, test, and ship apps to the Google Play Store. 

 Requirements 
 Experience building and maintaining Android applications. Strong proficiency in Android development using Kotlin. Experience with build tools such as Gradle, GitHub Actions. Understanding of Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) practices. Experience with asynchronous programming and reactive development patterns. Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Experience with performance analysis and application optimization. Ability to work with and modernize legacy codebases. Experience writing unit, integration, and automated tests. Familiarity with open-source frameworks and development practices. Experience working within globally distributed teams. Strong self-management, communication, and time management skills. Experience integrating mobile applications with backend services and RESTful APIs. 

 Qualifications 
 Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or equivalent. Experience: 3+ years of hands-on Android development experience. Technical Skills: MVI Architecture Technical Skills: Kotlin Technical Skills: Jetpack Compose Technical Skills: OkHttp Technical Skills: Java Technical Skills: JUnit Tools: Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, VS Code, Android Studio, Azure

title: AVP: Principal Engineer (DSG Scale)
description:
Business Unit: Data Strategy Group Industry: No Industry Overview Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI) is a leading global investment bank recognized for delivering independent strategic and financial advice to corporations, financial sponsors, and governments. With uniquely deep industry expertise, broad international reach, and a partnership approach rooted in trust, the firm provides innovative, integrated solutions across mergers and acquisitions, capital solutions, financial restructuring, and financial and valuation advisory. Our unmatched transaction volumes provide differentiated, data-driven perspectives that help our clients achieve their most critical goals. To learn more about Houlihan Lokey, please visit HL.com. Scope We are seeking a highly accomplished Principal Engineer to serve as the technical authority and architectural leader for our cloud-native platform and infrastructure within the Financial Platform organization. In this role, you will define the platform architecture roadmap, design mission-critical infrastructure patterns, and lead the technical execution of platforms that power large-scale, distributed financial applications. Key Responsibilities Platform Architecture & Strategic Direction: Define and drive the target-state architecture for our next-generation, cloud-native platform (Kubernetes, multi-region cloud topologies, and AI/workload enablement). Translate overarching business goals into scalable, resilient, and decoupled platform capabilities. Modern Web & End-to-End Automation with Playwright: Standardize and implement Playwright for modern browser and web application automation, utilizing browser context isolation, parallel test execution, request interception, and resilient auto-waiting mechanisms for frontend platform portals. Automated Regression, Integrated & Functional Testing: Architect and drive automated testing frameworks across the platform lifecycle, establishing continuous automated regression suites across CI/CD environments, multi-service integrated testing across distributed microservices and event brokers, and end-to-end functional automated tests validating complex financial workflows and edge cases. Hands-On Core Engineering: Lead by example by writing production-grade code, building foundational custom tooling/operators (Typescript, Python), authoring reusable Terraform modules, and designing reference implementations for engineering teams. Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Serve as a mentor and technical coach to junior and mid-level engineers. Facilitate design reviews, establish architecture RFC processes, conduct deep code/infrastructure reviews, and foster a strong culture of engineering excellence. Enterprise CI/CD & Developer Experience (DevEx): Architect automated, self-service golden paths and progressive delivery pipelines (canary, blue-green) that minimize cognitive load for application developers while ensuring strict deployment guardrails. Observability, SRE & Chaos Engineering: Design holistic telemetry strategies utilizing OpenTelemetry. Define enterprise SLI/SLO standards, error budget policies, resilience testing/chaos engineering, and lead complex root-cause analyses (RCA) for critical production incidents. 
 Basic Qualifications Experience: 7+ years of hands-on experience in Platform Engineering, QA Automation, SRE, Distributed Systems, or Cloud Architecture, with a proven track record of designing and operating large-scale, production-grade distributed systems. Architecture & System Design: Demonstrated expertise in architecting complex, highly available, fault-tolerant, and secure cloud topologies (AWS, Azure, or GCP). Automated Test Engineering Mastery: Demonstrated proficiency in architecting automated regression, integration, and functional test frameworks; extensive hands-on experience with Playwright for web/UI testing and modern API testing tools. Security, Auth & Impersonation Validation: Hands-on experience testing and validating authentication/authorization modules (OAuth2, OIDC, JWT), RBAC access matrices, and user impersonation security logic. Infrastructure-as-Code Mastery: Mid-level proficiency with Terraform (custom provider/module development, state locking, drift detection) and Policy-as-Code engines (e.g., OPA, Rego, Kyverno). Mentorship & Influence: Proven track record of guiding junior engineers, driving engineering consensus across disparate teams, and leading technical initiatives without direct authority. Observability & Reliability: Hands-on experience with modern observability platforms, distributed tracing with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana ecosystems, and enterprise SRE practices. Education: Bachelor s or Master s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Preferred Qualifications Experience architecting platforms within highly regulated domains (e.g., Financial Services, FinTech, Banking). Deep experience with Securing Cloud Native Platform. Experience designing, building, or operating large-scale Data Platforms is highly desirable. Active contributions to open-source cloud-native projects (CNCF ecosystem).
